item.title: Building Effective AI Agents & Claude Code Best Practices
item.author: yrong1997@gmail.com (Ronyang)
item.description: When building AI agents, the most successful implementations typically rely on simple, composable patterns rather than overly complex frameworks. Agentic systems generally fall into two categories: workflows, where LLMs and tools are orchestrated through predefined code paths, and agents, where LLMs dynamically direct their own processes and tool usage.
